== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The first surviving text limits the opponent’s loss to 2 Force from Fear Will Keep Them In Line. The remaster cancels the specifically marked virtual card. Both retain the unique Imperial-class bonuses and one two-Force battleground system deployment in your deploy phase.
